name: Righteous
old_description: Apparel Fulfillment Services Built for Growth, Backed by Real People
about:
Righteous began in the late 1980s when Aly and Rick Salz, frustrated by inconsistent quality and unreliable vendors in the corporate apparel market, launched Righteous Clothing Agency in Pasadena, California. The company later moved its headquarters to Clackamas, Oregon, where it operates today.

Today Righteous operates as a full-service apparel partner, handling custom screen printing, embroidery, design, warehousing, kitting, and fulfillment through a dual-warehouse network in Oregon and Missouri. The company manages online company stores for clients ranging from small teams to enterprises with thousands of employees, processing orders with real-time inventory and shipping in-stock items within two days. A staff of around 1,000 supports end-to-end program management, from creative design to nationwide distribution.

Righteous serves clients across restaurants and food service, industrial manufacturing and construction, healthcare, education, and grocery and convenience sectors. Its customer base includes multi-location restaurant chains such as Farrelli’s Pizza and Elmer’s Restaurants, construction firms like Pence Contractors, healthcare networks such as PeaceHealth, and brands including Dave & Buster’s, Great Harvest, and Craveworthy Brands.

The company was founded to solve the problem of messy printing, crooked logos, and vendors who disappointed when it mattered most. Righteous differentiates itself by assigning a dedicated account manager to each client, providing real-time inventory visibility, and managing the entire workflow from design through fulfillment so clients don’t have to juggle multiple vendors.
